# VeriScript

> Offline document restoration: photos, scans and PDFs become searchable PDFs, transcripts and Markdown, with a review queue that flags uncertain digits instead of guessing. Devanagari (Nepali/Hindi) first; English by the same pipeline. No cloud calls, no telemetry, no account. MIT.

## Tools
- [Nepali OCR](https://veriscript.live/nepali-ocr/): what it does, honest accuracy numbers, FAQ.
- [Live studio](https://veriscript.live/studio): one page at a time, no signup; demo uploads are deleted after 60 minutes.

## Evidence
- [Benchmark](https://github.com/DontHash/VeriScript/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARK.md): head-to-head CER on frozen Devanagari sets, with confidence intervals.
- [Evaluation](https://github.com/DontHash/VeriScript/blob/main/docs/EVALUATION.md): frozen manifests, metrics, reproduction commands.
- [Market landscape](https://github.com/DontHash/VeriScript/blob/main/docs/MARKET.md): positioning against OCRmyPDF, Tesseract, cloud APIs and IDP suites.

## Code
- [Repository](https://github.com/DontHash/VeriScript): Python CLI, FastAPI + SolidJS studio, MIT.
